Source: [4737](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4737); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Server Load Peak](../../api/values/server-load-peak.md).
